{{Top|leg}}
The [[Taptronics]] '''CovOps Mark III Surveillance Unit''' was a security device often used to monitor military bases and installations.

Capable of being disguised as [[Plant/Legends|plants]] or other common landscape items (rocks, logs, etc), each surveillance pod contains miniature [[Holocamera/Legends|holocameras]], motion and heat sensors, and high-gain [[Audio sensor/Legends|audio pickups]]. Capable of interfacing with a central command area, the Surveillance pod can either operate manually or in auto-mode - with the auto mode setting automatically, raising an alarm if it detects unauthorized signatures; with an scanning range of a hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. The Surveillance pod also had its own [[Battery/Legends|battery]], making it independent from larger power grids.
